name: RestoreBackup
transaction_boundary: cryptographic/database verification completes in isolated staging before quiesce; current live database is first preserved as verified emergency recovery copy; replacement uses LLD-01 atomic recovery choreography and is rolled back if restored-open/integrity/audit finalization fails
authoritative_reads: exact artifact digest and preview fingerprint
guards: staged SQLCipher DB passes schema/migration/FK/audit checks
idempotency: COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 plus restore operation identity; committed restored data_instance_id prevents duplicate replacement
receipt_order: preflight outside UoW -> acquire exclusive recovery state -> emergency verified backup -> verify again -> recoverable live-database/key-envelope replacement -> reopen/verify restored DB -> insert command_receipt + security.backup_restored audit/result refs in restored DB -> commit -> remove recovery marker
mutations: create and retain a verified emergency pre-restore managed-backup identity when current live state exists
atomically replace live authoritative database and target-installation protected live-DEK envelope from the fully verified stage
append restore command receipt/audit/result evidence inside the restored database
revision_effects: all restored domain/entity revisions and the restored data_instance_id remain exactly as carried by the verified backup; restore does not synthesize revision increments across restored domain rows; a newly created emergency backup catalog row starts at its normal creation revision and the restore receipt/audit are append-only evidence
post_commit_work: remove the recovery marker and allow the next readiness cycle to generate fresh run/session identities; retain the emergency pre-restore backup until normal verified-backup retention later proves it eligible
rules: no live mutation before complete verification
failed finalization restores prior verified database
portable source DPAPI state is never required because encrypted payload carries source live DEK
